source: "Here we are. Now then, it appears to be written in a strange format. One might even say a code of sorts... I have it! Apparently, the Talisman currently resides in the Great Void. A plane somewhat removed from ours. If thou wishest to gain access to this void, thou shalt need to craft two lenses: one concave, the other convex. Light focused through the properly enchanted lenses will open a conduit between our realm and the void. I believe this treatise speaks of three Talismans of Principle that send out a call to the Infinity Talisman and bring it here. Once here, it would seem that its sole purpose is to coerce a powerful force into the void." A thought hits the mage like lightning strikes a tree. "Oh no, Avatar... Thou shan't gain any more aid from me. I may be blind, but I see through thy sham. I'll not help thee send the Core into the void." Erethian falls silent, and it would appear that he'll speak no more.
translated: 「我們到了。現在看來，這似乎是用一種奇怪的格式寫成的。有人甚至會說是一種代碼……我知道了！顯然，護符目前位於大虛空之中。一個與我們的世界 somewhat 分離的位面。如果你希望進入這個虛空，你需要製作兩個透鏡：一個凹透鏡，另一個凸透鏡。通過正確附魔的透鏡聚焦的光線將打開一個連接我們領域和虛空的通道。我相信這篇論述提到了三個原則護符，它們發出召喚無限護符的信號並將其帶到這裡。一旦到達這裡，它的唯一目的似乎是迫使一股強大的力量進入虛空。」一個想法像閃電擊中樹木一樣擊中了法師。「哦不，化身……你不會再從我這裡得到任何幫助了。我可能失明，但我看穿了你的偽裝。我不會幫你將核心送入虛空。」Erethian 沉默下來，看來他不再說話了。」

source: "Here we are. Now then, it appears to be written in a strange format. One might even say a code of sorts... I have it! Apparently, the Talisman currently resides in the Great Void. translated: 「我們到了。那麼，看來這是以一種奇怪的格式書寫的。甚至有人會說，這是一種某種形式的密碼……我想到了！顯然，護符目前位於大虛空之中。一個與我們的位面略有不同的平面。如果你想要進入這個虛空，你必須製作兩片鏡片：一片凹透鏡，另一片凸透鏡。透過正確附魔的鏡片聚焦的光線，將打開我們領域與虛空之間的通道。我相信這份論文談論的是三枚原則護符，它們發出對無限護符的呼喚並將其帶到這裡。一旦到達這裡，它似乎唯一的目的是將一股強大的力量誘導進虛空。」一個念頭如閃電擊中樹木般閃過法師的心頭。「哦，不，天選者……你再也無法從我這裡獲得任何幫助了。我雖失明，卻能看穿你的偽裝。我不會幫你將核心送入虛空。」埃瑟里安沉默下來，看來他不再說話了。」

translated: 阿卡迪恩的聲音如靜水漣漪般在你耳邊低語：「別怕，我的主人。我對這些事情有些了解。」

source: Dracothraxus sniffs the air distastefully, "I sense my doom nearby. Perhaps I am to be released at long last. I wish thee good luck mortal. Defend thyself!"  With that, the dragon leaps at you.
translated: 德拉科薩克斯厭惡地嗅了嗅空氣：「我感覺到死亡臨近。也許我終於要被釋放了。祝你好運，凡人。保衛你自己！」說完，巨龍向你撲來。」

translated: 「你終於又來問了！」

source: "I simply cannot believe he is here!"
translated: 「我簡直不敢相信他就在這裡！」

source: "He is our town healer. He hath been here for years. Nice fellow."
translated: 「他是我們鎮上的治療師。他已經在這裡多年了。是個好人。」

source: "Well, ye'll have to come to the shop when it is open."
translated: 「嗯，你得等店裡開門的時候再來。」

source: "Oh. Never mind, then."
translated: 「哦，那就算了。」

source: "I have not seen my colleagues since they were last here. They are busy folk."
translated: 「自從他們上次在這裡之後，我就沒再見過我的同事們。他們都是忙碌的人。」

translated: 「哇！尿布！」

source: "Yes, Avatar?" Candice says.
translated: 「是的，天選者？」坎蒂絲說道。

source: "How may I help thee?" Patterson asks.
translated: 「我能為你做什麼呢？」帕特森問道。

source: "Another time, then."
translated: 「那麼，改天再說吧。」

source: "Very well. If thou didst not get the first two there is no good reason for me to continue now."
translated: 「很好。如果你連前兩個都沒拿到，我也沒有理由繼續下去了。」

source: "For a gold coin I will tell thee another. Dost thou wish to hear it?"
translated: 「一枚金幣，我就告訴你另一個秘密。你想聽嗎？」

source: "Dost thou wish to buy some spells?"
translated: 「你想買些法術嗎？」

source: You kiss Nastassia and she moans.
translated: 你吻了娜斯塔西婭，她輕聲呻吟。

translated: 「再見，阿瓦塔。」

source: "Very well, then!"
translated: 「好吧！」

source: "Thou cannot carry thy reward! My, thy travels have indeed been successful. Well, then, thou must endure a further test. Return the sealed box to me when thou canst tote the extra gold, and thou wilt be paid what thou dost deserve."
translated: 「很好！你的報酬太重了，你背不動。哎呀，你的旅程確實很成功。那麼，你必須再接受一項考驗。等你能負擔得起額外黃金的重量時，把那個密封的盒子還給我，我會付給你應得的報酬。」

source: "The smithy is currently closed for outside business. Thou shalt have to return some other time."
translated: 「鐵匠鋪目前不對外營業。你必須改天再來。」

source: Zorn dips the helmet in water to cool it.
translated: 佐恩將頭盔浸入水中降溫。

source: He hands you the helmet.
translated: 他將頭盔遞給你。

source: "Never mind, then!"
translated: 「算了，沒關係！」

source: "My magic is not working!"
translated: 「我的魔法失效了！」

source: "My name? You can call	me what you want, but I will only respond to Smith."
translated: 「名字？你想怎麼叫我都可以，但我只會回應『史密斯』這個稱呼。」

source: She takes the banner from you.
translated: 她從你手中接過旗幟。

source: "Mine apologies, milord, thou dost not have enough gold."
translated: 「抱歉，大人，你的金幣不夠。」

translated: 「瑪麗亞，你難道認不出你的老夥伴了嗎？」

source: "Friendly fellow -- I like him."
translated: 「友善的家伙——我喜歡他。」

source: "How many dost thou want?"
translated: 「你想要多少？」

source: "Here it is."
translated: 「在這裡。」

translated: 「你沒有足夠的黃金來購買這個，阿瓦塔。或許可以用其他東西交換。」

translated: 「在訓練時間內進行訓練。請你在那個時候回來找我。」

translated: 「成為石像鬼與人類的福祉。擁有一套哲學，幫助所有種族的生物達到他們潛力的最高境界。」

source: He turns to his right and speaks to no one.
translated: 他轉向右側，對著空氣說話。

source: He turns back to you and grins.
translated: 他轉回身來對著你咧嘴一笑。

source: "I already sold thee my last banana!"
translated: 「我已經把最後一根香蕉賣給你了！」

source: "I am sorry. A better time to discuss this would be when my shop is open."
translated: 「很抱歉。等我的店鋪開門時，再來討論這件事會比較合適。」

source: "To be a miner for the Britannian Mining Company."
translated: 「為不列顛尼亞礦業公司擔任礦工。」

source: The Cube vibrates.
translated: 立方體震動起來。

translated: 立方體震動起來。

source: "'Xorinia' always responds to free information. Transaction complete."
translated: 「'Xorinia' 總是回應免費資訊。交易完成。」

source: "Dost thou think me an invalid? Know that in my searches, I have faced dangers that would turn even one such as thee to quivering flesh."
translated: 「你以為我是個廢人嗎？要知道，在我的搜尋過程中，我曾面對過連你這樣的人都會嚇得渾身發抖的危險。」

source: The mage's eyes begin to glow softly. "My magic is strong enough to tear down the fabric of reality and reconstruct it as I see fit."
translated: 法師的眼睛開始發出柔和的光芒。「我的魔法強大到足以撕裂現實的結構，並按照我的意願重新建構它。」

source: "To prove this, I'll take on the form of a winged gargoyle noble..."
translated: 「為了證明這一點，我將化身為一隻有翼的石像鬼貴族……」

source: His hands move in passes you recognize as being magical, then he speaks softly the magic words,
translated: 他的雙手做出你認得是魔法的手勢，然後輕聲念出魔法咒語，

source: "Can I be of some small assistance in thy quest to release me. If so, thou hast but to ask." Arcadion's smile stretches from ear to ear.
translated: 「我能為你的解放之旅提供些許協助嗎？如果是的話，你只需開口。」Arcadion 的笑容從耳邊延伸到另一邊。

source: A wicked look of triumph flickers across Arcadion's face to be quickly replaced by a ludicrous semblance of gratitude, "Thou art truly courageous to vow to release me. My gratitude hath no bounds." An oily grin coats the daemon's face, "Thou hast made quite a powerful ally this day, mortal." His eyes blink in what is possibly meant to be a charming manner.
translated: 一絲邪惡的勝利神情在 Arcadion 臉上閃過，隨即被荒謬的感激表情取代，「你誓言解放我，確實勇氣可嘉。我的感激之情無以復加。」油膩的笑容覆蓋了這隻惡魔的臉龐，「你今天交了一位相當強大的盟友，凡人。」他的眼睛眨動著，或許是想表現得迷人一些。

source: "There was one on this island, that much I know. Find it. Bring it to me and together, we shall break this mirror which binds me to that blasted mage."
translated: 「這座島嶼上曾有一個，這一點我很清楚。找到它。帶給我，我們將一起打破將我束縛在那個可惡法師身上的鏡子。」

source: The daemon sword abruptly ceases its vibration. "This being is hardly worth a death the likes of which I would visit upon it. Call upon me again when thou art faced with a more worthy opponent."
translated: 魔劍突然停止了震動。「這傢伙根本不值得我對其施加死亡。當你面對更值得的對手時，再召喚我吧。」

source: "So long, my friend! Do not forg... I mean, do not lose how to play The Game!"
translated: 「再見了，我的朋友！別忘……我是說，別忘了怎麼玩《遊戲》！」

source: "Oh! Thou dost not have room for the scroll! Put down some of thy things and I can give it to thee!"
translated: 「哦！你的背包沒有空間放這張捲軸了！放下一些物品，我就可以把它給你！」

source: "Excellent! I have no doubt now that thou art the one true Avatar!"
translated: 「太棒了！現在我毫不懷疑你就是那位唯一真正的阿瓦塔（Avatar）！」

source: "Oh-- I almost forgot! The password to leave or enter the town is `Blackbird'!"
translated: 「哦——我差點忘了！離開或進入城鎮的密碼是『黑鳥』（Blackbird）！」

source: "Excellent! I have no doubt now that thou art the one true Avatar!"
translated: 「太棒了！現在我毫不懷疑你就是那位唯一真正的阿瓦塔（Avatar）！」

source: "I must help him, as he helped me! Wilt thou assist?"
translated: 「他幫助了我，我也必須幫助他！你願意協助嗎？」

source: "Very good," he says, notably relieved. "I thank thee in advance."
translated: 「很好，」他說著，顯得如釋重負。「我在此先感謝你了。」

source: "Then I must go this one myself," he says angrily. "'Tis no more than one friend would do for another... no more than Bollux did for me!"
translated: 「那麼，我必須親自去一趟了。」他憤怒地說道。「這不過是朋友之間該做的事……就像波魯克斯為我所做的一樣！」

source: He looks at you carefully. His stoney features do nothing to hide the suspicion on his face, or in his voice.
translated: 他仔細地打量著你。他那如石頭般堅硬的面容，絲毫無法掩飾臉龐與語氣中流露出的懷疑。

source: "It is quite obvious to me thou art but a lost traveler and certainly not the Avatar for whom I mistook thee."
translated: 「對我而言，你顯然只是一個迷路的旅人，絕非我誤認的那位阿瓦塔（Avatar）。」

source: "His eyes reveal his hope. As he takes the book from you, it almost appears as if he is smiling."
translated: 「他的雙眼透露出希望。當他從你手中接過書本時，幾乎看起來像是在微笑。」

source: "I must see the book the book to use it. Perhaps thou hast mislaid it about somewhere." He stares directly at you. "'Tis vital that I have that tome. I beg thee, retrieve it for me!"
translated: 「我必須親眼看看那本書才能使用它。也許你把它遺忘在某處了。」他直視著你。「那本書對我至關重要。我懇求你，幫我把它找回來！」

source: "Then I recommend thou dost search within my master's chambers for it. The pages contain words which may help my companion."
translated: 「那麼，我建議你在我的主人寢室裡尋找它。書頁中記載的文字或許能幫助我的同伴。」

source: "Thou art... carrying too much. Put something down and I can give this to you."
translated: 「你……攜帶的物品太多了。放下一些東西，我才能把這個給你。」

source: "To have healed the wounds."
translated: 「為了治癒那些傷口。」

source: "Done!"
translated: 「完成了！」

source: "Done!"

translated: 「那兩人能重逢真是令人欣喜。我只希望昆頓也能有同樣的結局。」她的聲音充滿了希望。

source: "It is about time you didst ask again!"
translated: 「你終於問了！」

translated: 「到了。現在看來，這似乎是用一種奇怪的格式寫成的。甚至可以說是一種密碼……我想起來了！顯然，護符目前位於大虛空之中。一個與我們的世界 somewhat 分離的位面。如果你想進入這個虛空，你需要製作兩片透鏡：一片凹透鏡，另一片凸透鏡。透過正確附魔的透鏡聚焦的光線將打開連接我們領域和虛空的通道。我相信這篇論述提到了三個原則護符，它們向無限護符發出召喚並將其帶到這裡。一旦到達這裡，似乎它的唯一目的就是迫使一股強大的力量進入虛空。」一個想法像閃電擊中樹木一樣擊中了法師。「哦不，化身……你不會再從我這裡得到任何幫助了。我雖然失明，但我看穿了你的偽裝。我不會幫你將核心送入虛空。」Erethian 沉默下來，看來他不再說話了。」

source: A wicked look of triumph flickers across Arcadion's face to be quickly replaced by a ludicrous semblance of gratitude, "you are truly courageous to vow to release me. My gratitude has no bounds." An oily grin coats the daemon's face, "you have made quite a powerful ally this day, mortal." His eyes blink in what is possibly meant to be a charming manner.
translated: 阿卡迪恩臉上閃過一絲邪惡的勝利神情，隨即迅速被一種荒謬的感激假象所取代。「你發誓要釋放我，真是勇氣可嘉。我的感激之情無以復加。」那惡魔臉上掛著油膩的笑容。「你今天結交了一位強大的盟友，凡人。」他的眼睛眨了眨，似乎想表現得迷人些。

source: "There was one on this island, that much I know. Find it. Bring it to me and together, we shall break this mirror which binds me to that blasted mage."
translated: 「這島上有一把，這點我很清楚。去找它。把它帶給我，我們就能一起打破這面將我束縛在那該死法師身上的鏡子。」

source: The daemon sword abruptly ceases its vibration. "This being is hardly worth a death the likes of which I would visit upon it. Call upon me again when you are faced with a more worthy opponent."
translated: 惡魔劍突然停止震動。「這個生物根本不值得我對其施加如此死法。當你面對更值得的對手時，再召喚我吧。」

source: "So long, my friend! Do not forg... I mean, do not lose how to play The Game!"
translated: 「再見了，我的朋友！別忘……我是說，別忘了怎麼玩『遊戲』！」

source: "Oh! you do not have room for the scroll! Put down some of your things and I can give it to you!"
translated: 「哦！你沒有空間放這卷軸！放下一些你的東西，我就可以給你！」

source: Who held the shrine so dear.
translated: 她如此珍視這座神龕。

source: She asked that her offspring do likewise
translated: 她要求她的後代也如此做，

source: And keep it so year after year.

source: Where Cove's lovers, both young and old,
translated: 那裡科維的情侶們，無論老少，

source: Could court outdoors in the dark!
translated: 都能在夜色中於戶外求愛！

source: Where the sun's brightness seemeth most fair.
translated: 那裡陽光的光芒顯得格外美麗。

translated: 而可憐的娜迪亞，瑪格達的女兒，

source: Of misfortune had more than her share!
translated: 不幸降臨於她，遠超其份！

source: To Julius, a not-so-wealthy young lad.
translated: 嫁給朱利葉斯，一個並不富裕的年輕男子。

source: He left her with child and went far away.
translated: 他留她一人撫養孩子，遠走他鄉。

source: As for Nadia's poor heart, It was sad.
translated: 至於納迪亞那顆可憐的心，充滿悲傷。

source: That Julius by a beast was killed;
translated: 朱利葉斯遭野獸殺害；

source: The child came early, It was a difficult birth;
translated: 孩子早產，生产过程艱難；

source: And Nadia's soul became chilled.
translated: 納迪亞的靈魂變得冰冷。

source: To the Shrine did Nadia run.
translated: 納迪亞奔向神殿。

source: She plunged the dagger into her own breast;
translated: 她將匕首刺入自己的胸膛；

source: Never again would she see the sun.
translated: 她再也不會見到太陽。

source: Unloved and unwanted by all;
translated: 無人愛她，亦無人需要她；

source: Today she walks cloaked in solitude
translated: 今日她披著孤寂的斗篷行走

source: Awaiting her destiny's call.
translated: 等待命運的召喚。

source: "Excellent! I have no doubt now that you are the one true Avatar!"
translated: 「太棒了！我現在毫不懷疑，你就是那位真正的化身！」

source: "Oh-- I almost forgot! The password to leave or enter the town is `Blackbird'!"
translated: 「噢——我差點忘了！進出城鎮的密碼是『Blackbird』！」

source: "Excellent! I have no doubt now that you are the one true Avatar!"
translated: 「太棒了！我現在毫不懷疑，你就是那位真正的化身！」

source: "I must help him, as he helped me! will you assist?"
translated: 「我必須幫助他，就像他曾幫助我一樣！你願意協助嗎？」

source: "Very good," he says, notably relieved. "I thank you in advance."
translated: 「太好了，」他說，顯得如釋重負。「在此先感謝你了。」

source: "Then I must go this one myself," he says angrily. "It is no more than one friend would do for another... no more than Bollux did for me!"
translated: 「那麼這事我必須親自去辦，」他憤怒地說。「這不過是朋友間應有的義氣……就像波魯克斯對我所做的那樣！」

source: He looks at you carefully. His stoney features do nothing to hide the suspicion on his face, or in his voice.
translated: 他仔細打量著你。他那如石頭般冷硬的臉龐，絲毫沒有掩飾住他臉上與語氣中的懷疑。

source: "It is quite obvious to me you are but a lost traveler and certainly not the Avatar for whom I mistook you."
translated: 「對我而言再明顯不過了，你不過是個迷途的旅人，絕不是我誤認的那位化身。」

source: "I must see the book the book to use it. Perhaps you have mislaid it about somewhere." He stares directly at you. "It is vital that I have that tome. I beg you, retrieve it for me!"
translated: 「我必須親眼看到那本書才能使用它。也許你把它遺落在某處了。」他直視著你。「拿到那本典籍至關重要。我懇請你，幫我找回來！」

source: "Please go and recover it then. I believe it contains information that may help my companion."
translated: 「那麼請去把它找回來吧。我相信書中記載的資訊或許能幫助我的同伴。」

source: "Then I recommend you do search within my master's chambers for it. The pages contain words which may help my companion."
translated: 「那麼我建議你在主人的房舍內搜尋它。書頁上的文字或許能幫助我的同伴。」

source: "you are... carrying too much. Put something down and I can give this to you."
translated: 「你……攜帶的物品太多了。放下一些東西，我才能把這個給你。」

source: "To have healed the wounds."
translated: 「治癒了傷口。」

source: "Done!"
translated: 「完成了！」

source: "Done!"
translated: 「完成了！」

source: Margareta turns away from you.
translated: 瑪格麗塔轉過身去，背對著你。

source: "Within it," she says, "you will find the Well of Souls."
translated: 「在裡面，」她說，「你會找到靈魂之井。」

source: "It is wonderful that those two have been brought back together. I only hope that Quenton will share that same fate." Her voice is full of hope.
translated: 「那兩人能重新團聚真是奇妙。我只希望昆頓也能有同樣的命運。」她的聲音充滿了希望。

source: "They brought you here along their way to Britain."
translated: 「他們在前往不列顛的路上把你帶到了這裡。」
